words.jelaw_fertilize_desc: Рассыпает выбранную костную муку. Чем выше навык «Земледелие», тем больше площадь.
words.jelaw_bonemeal_desc: Молотая кость. Немного ускоряет рост посевов.
words.jelaw_bonemeal_enriched_desc: Костная мука, смолотая с клыком и углем.
words.jelaw_bonemeal_enhanced_desc: Костная мука, смолотая с обугленной костью и живицей.

englishWords.jelaw_fertilize_desc: Spreads the selected bone meal. Covers a wider area as Farming rises.
englishWords.jelaw_bonemeal_desc: Ground bone. Hastens a crop a little.
englishWords.jelaw_bonemeal_enriched_desc: Bone meal ground with fang and charcoal.
englishWords.jelaw_bonemeal_enhanced_desc: Bone meal ground with charred bone and sap.

notes: English comes from Plugin.AddLocalization, which registers ten keys in the plugin's Jotunn CustomLocalization; tier names and descriptions come from Tier.All.
The plant hover suffix appends Tier.DisplayName (a static-initializer string) after vanilla localization in a Harmony postfix, so it has no display sink and stays English.
